summary.text: Marcia Kelbon is a candidate with no party preference for the Washington House of Representatives, District 24-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Kaylee Kuehn.
Kelbon placed first in the August 4, 2026 primary with 38.0% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Kelbon previously ran for the Washington State Senate in District 24 in 2024, appearing on the ballot as a Republican.
She advanced from the August 6, 2024 primary with 41.0% of the vote and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Democrat Mike Chapman, 45.1% to 54.8%.
